summary: Palomar Holdings filed an 8-K covering Q2 2026 results and declared an initial quarterly cash dividend of $0.45 per share. The dividend is payable September 2, 2026, to holders of record August 19, 2026. Results show net income of $52.6 million and adjusted net income of $63.8 million. This is a routine earnings and dividend declaration, not a special situation such as a capital return program, tender, or restructuring. No special-situation mechanics apply. Watch for continued dividend policy evolution, but no arbitrage angle exists.
